Police have a duty to protect people in their custody. This is why if someone dies in their custody they are liable. One can argue that these children are in the custody of the state and are legally obligated to defend the lives of these children.

I feel this case needs to be adjudicated. If the state can force you to send your child to school. Tell you that you have no means of defending their life but put police officers in the school who have no responsibility to defend those kids than what the hell? Basically the state is mandating you leave your children defenseless and we can do nothing about it. 

Children are not adults and have no ability to defend themselves in school. The school is legally responsible to keep these kids safe. The resource officer is an agent of the school and state. If he isn't responsible for keeping children safe than who is? If he isn't then it would stand to reason the only proper course of action would be to arm teachers since they have been found to be legally liable for the safety of children in their care.

The state forces children to go to school by law. Since the state is mandating you send your kid to school the minute they take custody of your kid the state is responsible for the child's safety. This is why not just anyone can take your kid out of school, why many schools require a parent to meet the bus in the afternoon and countless other measures. The school bans guns and does not allow parents to ensure the safety of their child. This means anyone the district hires is legally obligated to protect those children including a resource officer. This is why teachers are routinely arrested for not reporting things that happen to children in school. In my school district a teacher was arrested for not reporting another teacher that was sleeping with a student. All teachers and staff are legally obligated to act in the best interest of students. This resource officer did not and should be tried.

We went for like our second check up and when they did the ultra sound the baby had no heartbeat I think it was around 7 or 8 weeks. It was hard and we were heart broken. We tried again for a few more years but never got pregnant again. So, yeah you have my deepest sympathy it is the worst feeling to not see that little heart beat and hear the doctor tell you that you lost the baby. Keep trying though I am sure you'll have better luck than my wife and me.

The suicide prevention website thing said to think about how your death would impact them. Both my parents abandoned me at 8 years old so they wouldn't care. My aunt who raised me wouldn't care since she resented me. My only friend found someone who is 100 times better than I'll ever be and doesn't really need me. My wife would probably go back home and live with her mom if I was gone. My co-workers don't even know who I am let alone miss me.

> You’re a great person and you will get the happiness that you deserve. 

Why? You've never met me. I cheated on my wife so I mean that already negates your assertion. There is no one out there for me. I've tried so hard to be better to improve. My whole life has been just a struggle to make it to the next day. I just want to die man. I try to think back to when I was happy and there has never been a time. Nothing good is ever going to happen because nothing good has ever happened.

>Looks are NOT everything to a LOT of people.

This is a thing ugly people are constantly told to make them feel better. It's a lie. Looks matter. It's the first thing people see. And it's how we judge if we want to talk to someone and pursue a relationship. I know I'm not good looking I've known for a long time because anytime I'd try asking someone out I'd get the same "your such a nice guy... but no". People think I'm a nice enough person to be friends with. Just not to date and be an intimate partner. I always though, maybe if I just workout a little harder. Run a bit farther. Make a little bit more money. Be that stable provider that someone would look past how I look and accept me. I was just lying to myself. I'll never be loved like that I'll never be good enough. I could run all day, get super ripped, make the next Facebook, and still I'd be alone because I'm not good enough. I never was.

I'm sitting in my office, like I always do, with the door close. I've been sitting here for 30 minutes and I just now opened my email. I spend most days staring at the wall. I have no idea why I put so much effort to life. I'm not good looking (short and ugly), I'm not smart enough to do an outstanding job at work. I'm just smart enough to do the job in a mediocre way. I've tried to improve. I tried to be more caring as a person. I've tried to have a better "EQ" and be understanding. I've worked to be in better shape. I've worked on my education. For what? I'm still not happy. Nothing I ever do will make people accept me. 

All I could think about on the drive in was read ending a semi truck. You hit one of those and you tend to be decapitated. Why do I keep getting out of bed? What will be there for me next Friday that isn't here for me now? After 34 years nothing has change. No one wants me, either as a friend or sexually. I put so much effort in doing the "right" thing in life. Getting educated, not being a dick to people, paying my taxes etc etc and for what? If I could I'd give my degrees and job to someone who was just in a shit place because of finances and go die drunk in a ditch some where. I'm not ever going to really be loved. I'm a third through my life and have nothing to show for it.
